name: Kommando Snipa Boy

abilities.name: Sneaky Gitz
abilities.text: During the first round of combat in which a Kommando ambushes their opponent, they may use their Stealth dice pool of 8 for any Test.

options.name: MORE DAKKA!
options.text: For every ten Kommandos in the Mob, one may have one of the following options (while keeping their Choppa and Slugga):

mobAbilities.name: Kunnin' Infiltraters
mobAbilities.text: When a Mob of Kommandos makes a Stealth (A) Test, add +1 Icon to the result.

note: Kill Team stand-in (docs/kill-team.md, Kommandos): the Kommando (Core p.355) with its Slugga swapped for a Big Shoota (Core p.220) fitted with a Magnocular Scope (Core p.228: all Range penalties reduced by 2) and a Silencer (Core p.229: gains Silent; the Big Shoota is PROJECTILE). The scope has no weapon field, so it is named on the weapon.
